list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project_name FROM claudalytics.sessions ORDER BY project_name

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT session_id, concat(formatDateTime(max(last_event_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i', '${__timezone}'), '  ·  ', substring(session_id, 1, 8)) AS label FROM claudalytics.sessions WHERE $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY max(last_event_at) DESC

list.name: show_startup
list.label: Startup events
list.description: Show plugin_loaded, hook_registered, mcp_server_connection and managed_settings_resolved rows in Session History

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(LogAttributes['session.id']) AS sessions FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('user_prompt', 'api_request') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session)

panels.title: Total OTel Events

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS events FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND NOT startsWith(LogAttributes['event.name'], 'hooks.') AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session)

panels.description: Claude Code's own OTel events. Hook rows (hooks.*) are not counted, so the number is the same in OTel-only and OTel + hooks mode.

panels.title: $ per 1K Output Tokens [KAN-38]
panels.description: Unit economics health check: total spend divided by thousands of output tokens. Tracks cache efficiency and pricing drift regardless of usage volume.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens'])) = 0, NULL, sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd'])) / (sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens'])) / 1000.0)) AS cost_per_1k_out FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name']='api_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session)

panels.title: Events Over Time

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, count() AS events FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND NOT startsWith(LogAttributes['event.name'], 'hooks.') AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Claude Code's own OTel events. Hook rows (hooks.*) are not counted, so the number is the same in OTel-only and OTel + hooks mode.

panels.title: Model Usage

targets.rawSql: SELECT LogAttributes['model'] AS model, count() AS count FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'api_request' AND LogAttributes['model'] != '' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY model ORDER BY count DESC

panels.description: API requests per model (api_request events only).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens'])) AS input_tokens, sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens'])) AS output_tokens, sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_read_tokens'])) AS cache_read_tokens FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['tool_name'] AS tool_name, count() AS calls, countIf(LogAttributes['success'] = 'true') AS successes, countIf(LogAttributes['success'] != 'true') AS failures, round(countIf(LogAttributes['success'] = 'true') / count() * 100, 1) AS success_rate FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['tool_name'] NOT IN ('', 'SubagentHandback') AND LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'tool_result' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd'])) AS cost_usd FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['skill.name'] AS skill_name, count() AS calls, countIf(LogAttributes['invocation_trigger'] = 'user-slash') AS user_slash, countIf(LogAttributes['invocation_trigger'] = 'nested-skill') AS nested, countIf(LogAttributes['invocation_trigger'] NOT IN ('user-slash', 'nested-skill')) AS other, max(Timestamp) AS last_used FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND Body = 'claude_code.skill_activated' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY skill_name ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Memory Files
panels.description: Auto-memory file writes (Write/Edit) into user-project memory folders (~/.claude/projects/<proj>/memory/). Sourced from file_mutations. Note: memory recall/load is not observable — writes only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT project_name AS project, file_name AS file, action, count() AS writes, max(timestamp) AS last_written FROM claudalytics.file_mutations WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp)) AND positionCaseInsensitive(directory, '.claude/projects/') > 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(directory, '/memory') > 0 AND $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(session_id IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY project, file, action ORDER BY last_written DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Websites Visited [KAN-39]
panels.description: URLs from WebFetch, Bash and PowerShell commands and MCP page fetches, and WebSearch queries (OTel). WebSearch result URLs need OTel + hooks mode. Status and bytes exist only in rows written by hooks before the upgrade. source says what wrote the row: otel (Claude Code's own telemetry) or hook (the hook-capture plugin). It is empty on rows from before schema v7. A WebSearch call gives one otel row with the query and one hook row for each result URL.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source_tool AS tool, source, timestamp AS time, url, search_query AS query, http_status AS status, fetch_bytes AS bytes, domain FROM claudalytics.websites_visited WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp)) AND $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(session_id IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT JSONExtractString(LogAttributes['tool_parameters'], 'mcp_server_name') AS mcp_server, JSONExtractString(LogAttributes['tool_parameters'], 'mcp_tool_name') AS mcp_tool, LogAttributes['mcp_server_scope'] AS scope, count() AS calls, countIf(LogAttributes['success'] = 'true') AS successes, countIf(LogAttributes['success'] != 'true') AS failures, round(countIf(LogAttributes['success'] = 'true') / count() * 100, 1) AS success_rate, round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])), 0) AS avg_duration_ms, sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['tool_result_size_bytes'])) AS total_result_bytes, countIf(LogAttributes['error'] != '') AS errors FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['tool_name'] = 'mcp_tool' AND LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'tool_result' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY mcp_server, mcp_tool, scope ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Tool Decisions: Accept vs Reject (per tool, per source) [KAN-21]

targets.rawSql: SELECT LogAttributes['tool_name'] AS tool, concat(LogAttributes['source'], ':', LogAttributes['decision']) AS src_decision, count() AS n FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'tool_decision' AND LogAttributes['tool_name'] != 'SubagentHandback' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY tool, src_decision ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_read_tokens'])) / greatest(sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_read_tokens'])) + sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_creation_tokens'])) + sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens'])), 1) AS hit_rate FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'api_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, LogAttributes['model'] AS model, quantile(0.50)(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS p95, quantile(0.99)(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS p99 FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'api_request' AND LogAttributes['model'] != '' AND LogAttributes['duration_ms'] != '' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time, model

SELECT LogAttributes['tool_name'] AS tool, count() AS invocations, round(quantile(0.50)(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])), 0) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])), 0) AS p95_ms, max(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS max_ms FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'tool_result' AND LogAttributes['tool_name'] NOT IN ('', 'SubagentHandback') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY tool ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

SELECT JSONExtractString(LogAttributes['tool_input'], 'url') AS url, count() AS hits, round(quantile(0.50)(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])), 0) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])), 0) AS p95_ms, max(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS max_ms FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'tool_result' AND LogAttributes['tool_name'] = 'WebFetch' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY url ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Lines of Code per User (added vs removed) [KAN-26]

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['user.email'] AS user, sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'added') AS lines_added, sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'removed') AS lines_removed FROM claudalytics.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY user ORDER BY (lines_added + lines_removed) DESC

panels.title: Prompt Length Distribution [KAN-27]

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(floor(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['prompt_length']) / 100) * 100) AS bucket_chars, count() AS prompts FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'user_prompt' AND LogAttributes['delivery.mode'] != 'mid_turn' AND NOT startsWith(LogAttributes['prompt'], '<agent-message') AND NOT startsWith(LogAttributes['prompt'], '<task-notification') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY bucket_chars ORDER BY toUInt32OrZero(bucket_chars)

panels.description: Length of the prompt that starts each turn. Messages sent while Claude works (delivery.mode = mid_turn) are not counted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LogAttributes['session.id'] AS session_id, LogAttributes['user.email'] AS user, count() AS api_calls, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd'])), 4) AS cost_usd, sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens'])) AS tokens FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'api_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY session_id, user ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 20

WITH prompt_texts AS (SELECT LogAttributes['prompt.id'] AS pid, any(LogAttributes['session.id']) AS session_id, argMin(LogAttributes['prompt'], Timestamp) AS prompt_text FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'user_prompt' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY pid) SELECT any(pt.prompt_text) AS prompt, substring(any(pt.session_id), 1, 8) AS session, any(l.LogAttributes['user.email']) AS user, count() AS api_calls, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(l.LogAttributes['cost_usd'])), 4) AS cost_usd, sum(toUInt64OrZero(l.LogAttributes['input_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(l.LogAttributes['output_tokens'])) AS tokens FROM claudalytics.otel_logs l LEFT JOIN prompt_texts pt ON l.LogAttributes['prompt.id'] = pt.pid WHERE l.LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'api_request' AND l.LogAttributes['prompt.id'] != '' AND NOT startsWith(pt.prompt_text, '<agent-message') AND NOT startsWith(pt.prompt_text, '<task-notification') AND $__timeFilter(l.Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(l.ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(l.LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY pt.pid ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 20

WITH cost AS (SELECT toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS t, sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd'])) AS cost_usd FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'api_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY t), active AS (SELECT toStartOfHour(TimeUnix) AS t, sum(Value) AS active_sec FROM claudalytics.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.active_time.total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY t) SELECT c.t AS time, c.cost_usd / greatest(a.active_sec / 60, 1) AS cost_per_active_minute FROM cost c LEFT JOIN active a ON c.t = a.t ORDER BY time

panels.title: Commits vs Cost per Day [KAN-31]
panels.description: Commits come from Claude Code's claude_code.commit.count metric. It also counts a Bash command that only holds the text "git commit" (a heredoc, a search), so the number can be higher than the real commits.

targets.rawSql: WITH commits AS (SELECT toStartOfDay(TimeUnix) AS day, sum(Value) AS commits FROM claudalytics.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.commit.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY day), cost AS (SELECT toStartOfDay(Timestamp) AS day, sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd'])) AS cost_usd FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'api_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY day) SELECT coalesce(c.day, x.day) AS time, c.commits AS commits, x.cost_usd AS cost_usd FROM commits c FULL OUTER JOIN cost x ON c.day = x.day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Session History [KAN-50]
panels.description: Timeline of a session from Claude Code's OTel events: prompts (mid-turn messages marked), responses, API calls, tool decisions and results, subagents. Hook rows show only for what OTel cannot give: session start/end, config, cwd, instructions, notifications, subagent start, elicitation, teammate idle and WebSearch result URLs (OTel + hooks mode). Older hook rows that repeat OTel data show only for sessions recorded without OTel. Subagent tool calls are prefixed with ↳. source says what wrote the row: otel (Claude Code's own telemetry), hook (the hook-capture plugin) or transcript_backfill. It is empty on rows from before this label existed. One tool call can show as an otel row and a hook row; no row is left out. A hook row stores the subagent id as agent_id, like an OTel row; hook rows from before that stored it as agent.id, and this table reads both.

panels.title: Per-User Cost Leaderboard [KAN-36]
panels.description: Who's spending what. Joins api_request cost logs with commit and lines-of-code metrics so one row tells the full per-user productivity story.

targets.rawSql: WITH api AS (SELECT LogAttributes['user.email'] AS user, uniqExactIf(LogAttributes['session.id'], LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('user_prompt', 'api_request')) AS sessions, uniqExactIf(LogAttributes['prompt.id'], LogAttributes['event.name']='user_prompt' AND NOT startsWith(LogAttributes['prompt'], '<agent-message') AND NOT startsWith(LogAttributes['prompt'], '<task-notification')) AS prompts, countIf(LogAttributes['event.name']='api_request') AS api_calls, sumIf(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd']), LogAttributes['event.name']='api_request') AS cost_usd, sumIf(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens'])+toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens']), LogAttributes['event.name']='api_request') AS tokens FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['user.email']!='' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) GROUP BY user), commits AS (SELECT Attributes['user.email'] AS user, sum(Value) AS commits FROM claudalytics.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='claude_code.commit.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) GROUP BY user), loc AS (SELECT Attributes['user.email'] AS user, sumIf(Value, Attributes['type']='added') AS lines_added FROM claudalytics.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) GROUP BY user) SELECT a.user AS user, a.sessions AS sessions, a.prompts AS prompts, a.api_calls AS api_calls, round(a.cost_usd, 4) AS cost_usd, a.tokens AS tokens, c.commits AS commits, l.lines_added AS lines_added FROM api a LEFT JOIN commits c ON a.user = c.user LEFT JOIN loc l ON a.user = l.user ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Recent Errors (cross-session) [KAN-37]
panels.description: Failed tool calls across all sessions, newest first. Filter by tool/user/session to diagnose cross-session incidents. Cross-session by design — ignores the ${session} template variable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS time, substring(LogAttributes['session.id'], 1, 8) AS session, LogAttributes['user.email'] AS user, LogAttributes['tool_name'] AS tool, concat(LogAttributes['error'], ' · ', LogAttributes['tool_input']) AS detail, toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms']) AS duration_ms FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name']='tool_result' AND LogAttributes['success']='false' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT LogAttributes['survey_type'] AS survey, LogAttributes['event_type'] AS stage, count() AS n FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'feedback_survey' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY survey, stage ORDER BY survey, stage

panels.title: Subagent Usage [KAN-45]
panels.description: Subagent (Agent tool) overview. 'calls', 'successes' and 'failures' count the Agent tool calls that start a subagent. 'completed_runs', 'total_run_ms' and 'avg_run_ms' come from the subagent_completed events of the same session and subagent type: a run is one finished turn of a subagent, so a subagent that is continued later counts as more than one run, and a subagent that is still running is not counted yet. The run time is the real work time, also for background subagents (the Agent tool call of a background subagent returns after a few milliseconds). 'model' shows 'inherit' when no subagent_completed event and no explicit model exist. 'subagent_type' may be plugin-namespaced (e.g. superpowers:code-reviewer) or bare (e.g. general-purpose, Explore).

targets.rawSql: WITH completed AS (SELECT LogAttributes['session.id'] AS session_id, LogAttributes['agent_type'] AS agent_type, any(LogAttributes['model']) AS model, count() AS runs, sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS run_ms FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'subagent_completed' GROUP BY session_id, agent_type) SELECT JSONExtractString(LogAttributes['tool_input'], 'subagent_type') AS subagent_type, coalesce(nullIf(completed.model, ''), nullIf(JSONExtractString(LogAttributes['tool_input'], 'model'), ''), 'inherit') AS model, count() AS calls, countIf(LogAttributes['success'] = 'true') AS successes, countIf(LogAttributes['success'] != 'true') AS failures, round(countIf(LogAttributes['success'] = 'true') / count() * 100, 1) AS success_rate, arraySum(arrayMap(run -> run.2, groupUniqArray((completed.session_id, completed.runs, completed.run_ms)))) AS completed_runs, arraySum(arrayMap(run -> run.3, groupUniqArray((completed.session_id, completed.runs, completed.run_ms)))) AS total_run_ms, if(completed_runs = 0, 0, round(total_run_ms / completed_runs, 0)) AS avg_run_ms, max(Timestamp) AS last_used, any(JSONExtractString(LogAttributes['tool_input'], 'description')) AS sample_description FROM claudalytics.otel_logs AS dispatch LEFT JOIN completed ON completed.session_id = dispatch.LogAttributes['session.id'] AND completed.agent_type = JSONExtractString(dispatch.LogAttributes['tool_input'], 'subagent_type') WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['tool_name'] = 'Agent' AND LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'tool_result' AND ($__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project)) AND ($__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session)) GROUP BY subagent_type, model ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Blocked Actions by Tool [KAN-58]
panels.description: Rejected tool calls from OTel tool_decision, split by reason: user_reject, user_abort (the permission ask was interrupted), config or hook. Rows marked 'legacy: no PostToolUse' come from hook data written before the upgrade: a PreToolUse with no PostToolUse, which also counted interrupted calls.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tool_name AS tool, if(decision_source = '', 'legacy: no PostToolUse', decision_source) AS reason, count() AS blocked, any(tool_input) AS sample_input FROM claudalytics.blocked_tools FINAL WHERE completed = 0 AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp)) AND $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(session_id IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY tool, reason ORDER BY blocked DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Blocked Rate Over Time [KAN-58]
panels.description: Rejected tool calls per interval, one series per reason (user_reject, user_abort, config, hook). 'legacy: no PostToolUse' is hook data from before the upgrade.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(toDateTime(timestamp)) AS time, if(decision_source = '', 'legacy: no PostToolUse', decision_source) AS reason, count() AS blocked FROM claudalytics.blocked_tools FINAL WHERE completed = 0 AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp)) AND $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(session_id IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY time, reason ORDER BY time

panels.title: Compaction Events [KAN-59]
panels.description: One row per compaction. OTel compaction rows carry their own duration and tokens. Rows written by hooks before the upgrade are pre/post pairs: their duration is computed and they have no token counts.

targets.rawSql: WITH pre AS (SELECT session_id AS sid, timestamp AS t_pre, trigger AS trig, custom_instructions AS ci FROM claudalytics.compaction_events WHERE event_phase = 'pre' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp)) AND $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(session_id IN (${session:singlequote}), $session)), post AS (SELECT session_id AS sid, timestamp AS t_post FROM claudalytics.compaction_events WHERE event_phase = 'post' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp))) SELECT * FROM (SELECT substring(pre.sid, 1, 8) AS session, t_pre AS time, trig AS trigger, ci AS custom_instructions, dateDiff('millisecond', t_pre, t_post) AS duration_ms, toUInt64(0) AS pre_tokens, toUInt64(0) AS post_tokens FROM pre ASOF LEFT JOIN post ON pre.sid = post.sid AND pre.t_pre <= post.t_post UNION ALL SELECT substring(session_id, 1, 8) AS session, timestamp AS time, trigger, custom_instructions, toInt64(duration_ms) AS duration_ms, pre_tokens, post_tokens FROM claudalytics.compaction_events WHERE event_phase = 'compaction' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp)) AND $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(session_id IN (${session:singlequote}), $session)) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Compaction Frequency [KAN-59]
panels.description: Compactions per interval: OTel compaction rows plus the pre rows of the older hook pairs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(toDateTime(timestamp)) AS time, count() AS compactions FROM claudalytics.compaction_events WHERE event_phase IN ('pre', 'compaction') AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp)) AND $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(session_id IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sessions With Config Changes [KAN-60]
panels.description: Distinct sessions with a settings change (ConfigChange hook). Needs OTel + hooks mode: OTel has no config-change event, so this stays at 0 in OTel-only mode.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countDistinct(LogAttributes['session.id']) AS sessions_with_config_change, count() AS total_changes FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'hooks.ConfigChange' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND ($__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session))

panels.title: Config Changes — Audit Log [KAN-60]
panels.description: Settings changes during a session (ConfigChange hook): which settings file and source. Needs OTel + hooks mode: OTel has no config-change event, so this stays empty in OTel-only mode.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS time, substring(LogAttributes['session.id'], 1, 8) AS session, LogAttributes['source'] AS triggered_by, LogAttributes['file_path'] AS file, count() OVER (PARTITION BY LogAttributes['session.id']) AS changes_in_session, ResourceAttributes['project.name'] AS project FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'hooks.ConfigChange' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND ($__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session)) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200

defaults.noValue: No config changes. This panel needs OTel + hooks mode.

panels.title: Credential Exposures by Category [KAN-63]
panels.description: Sensitive files read with the Read tool, with Grep on the file itself, or with a shell read command (cat, type, head, tail, less, more, Get-Content, gc). A materialized view finds them by matching the path against 38 credential/secret file patterns.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pattern_category AS category, count() AS exposures FROM claudalytics.credential_exposures WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp)) AND $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(session_id IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY category ORDER BY exposures DESC

panels.title: Credential Exposure Detail [KAN-63]
panels.description: Each read of a sensitive file: the Read tool, Grep on the file itself, or a shell read command. This table holds the path, not the file text. In traces the collector puts a marker in place of the text of such a file, but not in every case: see Known limits in the README. source says what wrote the rows: otel (Claude Code's own telemetry). It is empty on rows from before schema v7, so a file read before and after the upgrade has two lines.

targets.rawSql: SELECT file_name, matched_label, pattern_category, source, count() AS times_accessed, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM claudalytics.credential_exposures WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp)) AND $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(session_id IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY file_name, matched_label, pattern_category, source ORDER BY times_accessed DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Most Modified Files [KAN-69]
panels.description: Every file Claude mutated (Edit=update, Write=write, a delete command in Bash or PowerShell=delete; changed = older FileChanged hook rows). No row limit — shows all touched files. In OTel-only mode, a delete after about character 128 of a long PowerShell command is not seen. source says what wrote the rows: otel (Claude Code's own telemetry). It is empty on rows from before schema v7, so a file changed before and after the upgrade has two lines.

targets.rawSql: SELECT file_name, file_extension, directory, source, count() AS total_mutations, countIf(action = 'update') AS updates, countIf(action = 'write') AS writes, countIf(action = 'delete') AS deletes, countIf(action = 'changed') AS changed, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions, max(timestamp) AS last_modified FROM claudalytics.file_mutations WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(timestamp)) AND $__conditionalAll(project_name IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(session_id IN (${session:singlequote}), $session) GROUP BY file_name, file_extension, directory, source ORDER BY total_mutations DESC

panels.title: Total Tokens
panels.description: Sum of all tokens: input + output + cache_read + cache_creation from api_request events.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_read_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_creation_tokens'])) AS total_tokens FROM claudalytics.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'api_request' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['project.name'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND $__conditionalAll(LogAttributes['session.id'] IN (${session:singlequote}), $session)
